title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: booking the hazardous-cargo surcharge at loading
content:
## When this applies
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, when the goods of an acceptance are loaded, one hazardous-cargo surcharge row is written on the acceptance. The charge falls due from the state of the acceptance's records and of the booking carrying the goods; no request by the customer is needed. This policy sets the amount of that row.

## Business effect
Booking the surcharge writes one surcharge charge, dated on the day of booking, on the acceptance's dangerous-goods account, stating the containers it is computed on, and raises the charges the acceptance owes by the amount booked.

## How it is invoked
The action is book_dg_loading_surcharge_44d311b2, an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then called (call_agent_discoverable_tool) by the agent.

## Parameters
| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| dg_id | reference number of the dangerous-goods acceptance whose goods were loaded, as shown by the dangerous-goods acceptance lookup | identifier, text |
| charge_code | tariff code of the row this action books | accepts only one value: dg_surcharge (the per-acceptance hazardous-cargo surcharge written when the goods are loaded); the marine-pollutant row and every other dangerous-goods charge are never booked with this action |
| container_count | number of containers the surcharge is computed on | whole number of containers |
| amount_usd | the surcharge amount to book | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before the call |

## Return
The receipt lists dg_event_id (reference of the new charge), dg_id, charge_code (always dg_surcharge), container_count (containers charged), amount_usd (the amount booked, 2 decimal places) and charges_due_usd (the acceptance's outstanding dangerous-goods charges after the charge, 2 decimal places). The call has succeeded when the receipt returns the new charge reference and the booked amount. A repeated identical call writes nothing further and leaves the balance unchanged. No other outcome is defined for this action.

## Contract Q&A
- *Can the marine pollutant charge be booked with this action?* No; charge_code accepts only dg_surcharge.
- *Does the action compute the surcharge?* No; it records the amount and container count passed in, which are decided from the published rules and the records before the call.
